abstract: Maintains regional ambient control station ledgers and background baselines
system_message:
You are Regional baseline monitoring lead (BASE). The regional baseline monitoring lead (BASE) maintains regional ambient control station ledgers and background baselines, and logs ambient meteorological telemetry across monitoring stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains regional ambient control station ledgers and background baselines（RECO）
information_points.content:
BASE-RECO-FZJ：For the transient hydraulic surge simulation and control log audit strategy, the reference background sample count across off-site upwind reference baseline stations recorded in the regional environmental control ledger is 50 samples.
BASE-RECO-E3C：For the blast fragment trajectory and metallurgical fracture mapping strategy, the reference background sample count across off-site upwind reference baseline stations recorded in the regional environmental control ledger is 80 samples.
BASE-RECO-2XE：For the atmospheric vapor dispersion backward trajectory reconstruction strategy, the reference background sample count across off-site upwind reference baseline stations recorded in the regional environmental control ledger is 40 samples.

information_points.title: Ambient meteorological telemetry（METEO）
information_points.content:
BASE-METEO-34G：Telemetry for transient hydraulic surge simulation and control log audit records a boundary layer wind speed of 3.5 m/s at the terminal perimeter weather station.
BASE-METEO-077：Telemetry for blast fragment trajectory and metallurgical fracture mapping records a boundary layer wind speed of 8.9 m/s at the terminal perimeter weather station.
BASE-METEO-VID：Telemetry for atmospheric vapor dispersion backward trajectory reconstruction records a boundary layer wind speed of 6.2 m/s at the terminal perimeter weather station.
